prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We accept the 18-month exclusivity in the field of cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil production as a trade for moving IP

content.text:
The researcher moved IP to uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence and reduced review to 60 days. I want company_owns results. I'll trade: accept uni_owns but push for option_to_assign instead of nonexclusive licence, and keep 60 days review. Or I could accept the 60 days and push back on IP to company_owns or at least uni_owns_option_to_assign.

Let me change two fields: IP to uni_owns_option_to_assign (better than nonexclusive, gives us option to take over if needed) and reviewDays back to 90 to protect our confidential process data.
